priorityList: Charge to engage and Pummel to interrupt enemy casts.
Use Recklessness and Avatar together, along with offensive Trinkets and Potions.
Cast Rampage if Rage is 100 or higher, or if Enrage is about to expire.
Cast Thunder Blast if you have 2 stacks of the Thunder Blast buff.
Cast Rampage if Recklessness is active to spend generated Rage.
Cast Thunder Blast while Avatar is active.
Cast Rampage to spend remaining Rage and maintain Enrage.
Cast Raging Blow if no higher priority abilities are ready.
Use Thunder Clap or Whirlwind as a low-priority filler.
